description: Annual festival of vintage, rare and limited-release beers at Red Hill Brewery. Head Brewer David Golding hosts guided vertical tastings pulled from the cellar including Imperial Stout; Pancho Mole Imperial Stout; Christmas Ale; Temptation and Mulled Mead. Regular tasting sessions scheduled across the weekend. Members of The Brewer's Secret Stash beer club get first access.
priceRange: Entry from AUD 10–30 (tastings priced separately; check website)
accessibilityNotes: Accessible parking; limited mobility path on sloped terrain; contact venue
weatherDependency: Outdoor event — weather-dependent; brewery has indoor covered areas
nearbyAttractions: Polperro Winery; Red Hill Truffles; Foxeys Hangout
suggestedItineraryPairing: Combine with Red Hill wine trail: Polperro; Foxeys; Red Hill Estate; consider Brewer's Cottage accommodation
